problem_meta.agent_answer:
## Predicted reaction

This is a **mixed-anhydride amide coupling**:

- **Carboxylic acid:** Fmoc-protected leucine derivative  
- **Amine:** aminoalkyl boronic ester  
- **Activator:** isobutyl chloroformate  
- **Base:** N-methylmorpholine  
- **Solvent:** dichloromethane  

The acid is first converted to a mixed anhydride, followed by nucleophilic attack from the primary amine.

## Major product

The expected product is the corresponding **Fmoc-protected carboxamide/dipeptide-like product**:

\[
\mathrm{Fmoc\text{-}Leu\text{-}C(O)NH\text{-}CH(CH_2CH_3)\text{-}B(OR)_2}
\]

The boronic ester and tert-butyl ester functionalities are expected to remain unchanged.

A representative product SMILES is:

```text
CC(C)C[C@H](NC(=O)OCC1c2ccccc2-c2ccccc21)C(=O)NC(CC)B1OC(C)(C)C(C)(CCC(C)CC(=O)OC(C)(C)C)O1
```

The stereochemistry at the aminoalkyl-boronate center cannot be assigned confidently from the supplied encoded structures. Isobutyl chloroformate, N-methylmorpholine, and dichloromethane are not incorporated into the final product.
